name: rentemester-workspace-inbox-handoff-claims-v26
sql:
CREATE TABLE rm_workspace_inbox_handoff_claims (
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rm_workspace_inbox_sources(source_id),
 company_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_hash)=64),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('claimed','completed')),
 claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 lease_expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 document_id INTEGER,
 document_no TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(source_id,company_slug)
);
CREATE TRIGGER rm_workspace_inbox_handoff_claims_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON rm_workspace_inbox_handoff_claims BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'workspace inbox handoff claims are durable'); END;
